 MARKETS Railway Stocks Rally: RVNL, RailTel Gain Up to 7% as Valuations Improve
 November 11, 2026 November 11, 2026 
 Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) and RailTel led the gains, rising more than 6% each. 
 Railway stocks recorded a strong rally on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, as investors returned to railway public sector companies after nearly two years of weak performance. 
 The buying came alongside a broader market recovery, with the Sensex rising around 1.5% and the Nifty gaining about 1.3% in early trade.
 Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL) and RailTel led the gains, rising more than 6% each to trade around Rs 215 and Rs 264, respectively. IRFC stock gains 5.5% to Rs 88.15, while IRCON International advanced 5.1% to Rs 117.05. IRCTC share price rises 4.5% to Rs 480.70. 
 RITES climbed 4% to Rs 202.45, Titagarh Rail Systems gained 3.5% to Rs 727.60, and Container Corporation of India (CONCOR) rose 2.2% to Rs 454. Rail stocks jump over 5% as investors return to counters that had faced a prolonged correction. RVNL shares climb more than 6%, while RailTel also records similar gains.
 The latest gains appear to be a recovery after almost two years of underperformance. The correction has moderated valuations, making some railway companies relatively attractive for long term investors.
 Over the past 12 months, RVNL and IRCTC had each declined 32%, compared with a 1.2% fall in the Nifty. IRFC, IRCON and RailTel lost between 25% and 30%, while RITES declined 7% and CONCOR fell 13%.
 Expectations of higher railway infrastructure allocations in the upcoming Budget could support sentiment. However, investors should not rush into these stocks, as the expected allocation remains uncertain. 
 The latest railway stocks rally indicate a recovery, but a sustained sector rally will depend on future government spending and business performance.
